in_sanskrit.name: Diwaker
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of wisdom and knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Diwaker एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Diwaker is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Deep' meaning 'a row of lamps' or 'a lamp'. In Hindu mythology, Diwaker is the god of wisdom and knowledge, who is believed to light the path of knowledge for his devotees. He is also associated with the moon and is known as the 'God of Nights'.
